text: とおく　みなみに　１のしま　という　ちいさな　しまが　あってな　ともだちに　よばれて　いくとこ　なんやけど…　どや　いくか？

structure.jp: １のしま　という　ちいさな　しまが　あってな
structure.en: there's a little island called One Island, y'see

structure.jp: ともだちに　よばれて
structure.en: I was invited by a friend, and

structure.jp: いくとこ　なんやけど…
structure.en: I'm just about to go, but...

patterns.name: 〜という (called)
patterns.span: １のしま　という　ちいさな　しま
patterns.explanation: A name plus という before a thing means 'the thing called' that name. １のしま という ちいさな しま = 'a little island called One Island'.

patterns.name: 〜ところだ
patterns.explanation: A plain verb plus ところだ means 'just about to' do it; とこ is the short form and なんや is Kansai dialect for なんだ. いくとこ なんや = 'I'm just about to go'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.span: ともだちに　よばれて
patterns.explanation: よばれる turns 'invite' into 'be invited', and に shows who did the inviting. ともだちに よばれて = 'invited by a friend, and'.
